name: data-room
description: A comprehensive Data Room web application for secure file and folder management

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --prefix backend --if-present && npm run test:integration --prefix frontend --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev

author: Data Room Team
